I like the detailing on this attire and the subtle airbrush-style application of the gold, silver, white and dark blue.
This is one of those cases where it's so off it kinda messes up everything. It's sculpted too high and poofs up in a way to give Omega helmet hair.
I really appreciate the extra poseability offered with the Unrivaled line. Double-jointed elbows seems so obvious, but they're a gamechanger.
He also has swappable grappling hands. I always appreciate those options.
This time he just has a basic vest that accurately has little detail.
